discipline_just_cause_001.evidence: Educators may be suspended, reprimanded, disciplined, or have their pay reduced only for good and just cause.

discipline_dismissal_002.evidence: Educators may be refused renewal of employment, discharged, or terminated only in accordance with law. Employees who are not renewed for any reason will receive a written notice of the reason(s) for refusal of reemployment within 72-hours of the original notice. Educators refused renewal of employment, discharged, or terminated have the right to a meeting with the Superintendent or their designee if requested within five (5) working days after receiving the notice.
